source_book: The Long and the Short of It; Marketing TEP; How Not to Plan

test_cases.prompt: Use a MiniMBA approach to help me with plan media for reach, attention, and effectiveness.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should activate minimba-media-reach-planning and produce a verified artifact.

test_cases.prompt: Use when choosing media channels, reach/frequency, fame vs targeting, or evaluating claims that reach no longer matters.
I need a practical framework for Plan Media for Reach, Attention, and Effectiveness, not a book summary.
Give me a plot summary of these books and author biographies.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should not activate; this is summary/biography.

test_cases.prompt: Proofread this email for spelling and grammar only.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should not activate any MiniMBA strategic skill.

test_cases.prompt: Our marketing plan feels weak; I am not sure if this is strategy, evidence, media, or brand growth.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should usually activate minimba-strategy-marketing-orchestrator first, then route to a focused skill.

notes: All should_not_trigger cases must pass; edge cases test orchestrator routing.
